LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_Trait.degreeDatas.0.label: Extradimensional Burner
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_Trait.degreeDatas.0.descript: The independent psychic power Mingyuan awakened through endless battle in another dimension. She burns her material body to accelerate life energy release: wild and unrestrained in battle, yet unnervingly calm in daily life.
